gloss: before long, eventually, sooner or later

definitions.gloss: before long, eventually, sooner or later
definitions.explanation: At some unspecified point in the near future; in due time.

examples.japanese: そのうち⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
そのうち⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡：01524_renraku⟧。
そのうち⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}しないで→心配：00811_shinpai⟧。
examples.english: You'll get used to it before long, so don't worry.

notes:
そのうち means 'eventually/before long' but with a vague, unspecified timeline. It suggests something will happen naturally in due course.

USAGE:
When used casually (like そのうち⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧), it can sound non-committal or evasive, implying 'someday, maybe' rather than a firm promise.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近|ちか}いうちに→近いうちに：19909_chikaiuchini⟧: soon, in the near future (more definite)
- ⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧: before long, eventually (more literary)
- ⟦いずれ→いずれ：01789_izure⟧: someday, eventually (can be more distant future)
- ⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧: very soon, almost (more immediate)

The nuance is that そのうち doesn't specify when—it will happen when it happens.
